commits.subject: harness-view slice 1: live path and area text in the window: the viewer shapes the story of every StudioPathText/StudioAreaText binding for composite (VectorAssets::shaped_story) with the text layers' font resolution and shaping; unshaped stories keep vector_text_not_provided with the reason (Viewer::vector_text_reports, state_json edit.vector.live_texts); Viewer::bind_live_text(_with_font) writes the story and the binding as one undo step

capabilities_done: slice 1: LiveTextAssets in view/vector.rs wraps EntryAssets and implements VectorAssets::shaped_story for the window's render path (prepared_vectors, render_folio_vectors): the story comes from the document's `text` entry and is shaped by text::shaped_story, which resolves every character range's font/size/fill through the same helper text layers now use (text::character, factored out of shape_layers; no second font resolution) and shapes through text::shaped_glyphs (Type TextEngine, same limits/errors); glyph outlines from that font; one paint row per distinct range fill

an unshapeable story (missing, stored content, unknown or broken font, mixed faces, Type refusal) stays None: composite draws the layer without it and reports vector_text_not_provided; the viewer keeps the reason (Viewer::vector_text_reports -> VectorTextStatus{report, unshaped}; state_json()[edit][vector][live_texts], computed only when the entry has bindings)

Viewer::bind_live_text / bind_live_text_with_font(layer, text, LiveTextKind::Path | Area{inset_pt}): Folio story (text_kind path/area, styles as place_text: text_size_pt, brush colour) in the text entry, then ONE entry-only undo step writing StudioPathText (whole first path, default options) or StudioAreaText (inset, first baseline ascent, auto-size off); one live binding per layer (a new one replaces the old); refused: open path for area text, empty/multi-line/oversized text, unregistered font, non-finite or out-of-range inset, non-vector layer

notes.spec_basis: v02.225 spec-modules/14-studio-creative-suite.md: [STU-TYP-002] (line 9393) area = text reflowed inside a closed container with overflow/overset state, path = text along an open or closed path; [STU-TYP-004] (9401) text-on-path binds a path story to a StudioVectorPath; [STU-TYP-120] (7994) path-text geometry start_t/end_t segment-relative; [STU-VEC-038] (4993) a vector path is usable as a typographic baseline and a text-frame boundary, text owned by the Typography engine
notes.declared_readings: one font and size per live story; run metrics = ink extents of the story's glyphs (Type exposes no font vertical metrics to the harness, as view/vector/path_text.rs), cap/x height = that ascent; leading = character style line height (auto = 120% of size); alignment from the first paragraph style (justified -> left); space/tab clusters are break opportunities, LF/U+2029 end a paragraph (bind refuses LF); glyph x/y offsets not carried (composite ShapedGlyph has none); path binding spans the whole first contour (end_t = its segment count); story/style ids derive from the layer uuid (character style flips the RFC variant nibble)

state_json()["edit"]["vector"]["live_texts"] lists each binding: placed / overset glyphs and the area container, or code vector_text_not_provided with the viewer's unshaped reason.
